assertions.subject: Mononeuropathy
assertions.quote: Peripheral neuropathies may affect one nerve (mononeuropathy)

assertions.subject: Mononeuropathy
assertions.predicate: involvement of a single discrete nerve
assertions.quote: Peripheral neuropathies may affect one nerve (mononeuropathy)

assertions.subject: Multiple mononeuropathy
assertions.quote: Peripheral neuropathies may affect several discrete nerves (multiple mononeuropathy, or mononeuritis multiplex)

assertions.subject: Polyneuropathy
assertions.quote: Peripheral neuropathies may affect multiple nerves diffusely (polyneuropathy)

assertions.subject: Guillain-Barre syndrome
assertions.predicate: damage to multiple segments of cranial nerves
assertions.quote: in the most common variant of Guillain-Barre syndrome, multiple segments of cranial nerves, usually the 2 facial nerves, may be affected

assertions.subject: Demyelination
assertions.quote: Damage to the myelin sheath (demyelination— slows nerve conduction

assertions.subject: Acquired demyelinating polyneuropathy
assertions.predicate: severe motor weakness with minimal atrophy
assertions.quote: The hallmark of acquired demyelinating polyneuropathy is severe motor weakness with minimal atrophy

assertions.subject: Vasculitis or ischemia
assertions.quote: These disorders result in smallfiber sensory dysfunction (sharp pain and burning sensations)

assertions.subject: Toxic-metabolic or genetic disorders
assertions.quote: Toxic-metabolic or genetic disorders usually begin symmetrically

assertions.subject: Immune-mediated processes
assertions.quote: Immune-mediated processes may be symmetric or, early in rapidly evolving processes, asymmetric
